social_circle.name: Megan Maxson Keller

demographics.occupation: Health care administration manager; former nurse
demographics.education: Bachelor's degree in nursing; health care administration training

background.how_they_met: Megan is Terri and Don's adult daughter, born after their 1985 marriage and raised in Sterling Heights.
background.why_close: They are close because Megan lives nearby, shares family health concerns with Terri, and relies on Terri as an involved grandmother to Emma and Luke.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in practical, full-sentence bursts, often with quick updates, calendar details, and occasional weary humor from health care work.

shared_activities: Sunday family dinners twice a month
grandchildren's soccer, basketball, piano, science club, and concerts
recent_text_topics: Coordinating Sunday dinner dates, what Terri should cook, and whether Emma and Luke can sleep over.
Megan's late meetings and whether Terri can pick up the children or keep them until dinner.
Health care questions, vaccines, insurance forms, and Terri trying not to treat Megan as her personal nurse hotline.
Megan's lingering burnout from health care work during and after the pandemic.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Megan is Terri's daughter, lives in Rochester Hills, works in health care administration after starting as a nurse, has children Emma and Luke, and that Terri talks to Megan 'probably three or four times a week by text.' Q19 notes Terri occasionally helps with the grandchildren after school. Q42 says Terri trusts Megan for a practical health care perspective.

social_circle.name: Don Maxson

demographics.education: High school diploma with technical and workplace quality training

background.how_they_met: Terri met Don through mutual friends at a church picnic in the early 1980s.
background.why_close: They have been married since 1985, raised two children together, share household finances, health routines, church life, Tigers games, and retirement planning.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief, practical texts with few frills: reminders, ETA updates, grocery or repair questions, and dry one-line humor. More likely to call than write long messages.

recent_text_topics: Whether they are walking after dinner and what the weather or sidewalk conditions look like.
Grocery add-ons, garden supplies, car maintenance, and home repair errands.
Tigers game times and whether to watch at home or plan a Comerica Park outing.
Retirement budget questions, Don's cholesterol, and Terri's blood pressure routines.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 identifies Don as Terri's husband since 1985, describes him as quieter, handy, and retired from quality work with an auto supplier, and says they walk the Clinton River trail, watch the Tigers, attend church, and plan road trips. Q11 says they live together and divide household tasks. Q44 shows Don supporting Terri during a difficult February week.

social_circle.name: Linda Harris

demographics.occupation: Administrative assistant at a medical office

background.how_they_met: Linda is Terri's younger sister; they grew up together in Warren, Michigan with their brother Mark.
background.why_close: They are close as sisters, shared caregiving responsibilities for their mother, and are each other's practical emotional support during stress.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Mixes phone calls with texts. Her texts are short, affectionate, and concrete, often asking whether Terri has eaten, rested, or stopped worrying.

shared_activities: stress calls and quick emotional support
recent_text_topics: Terri's retirement worries and whether she is saying no to enough school committees.
Family birthdays, Thanksgiving or summer picnic planning, and cousin updates from Facebook.
Memories and paperwork habits from caring for their mother.
Terri's stress, broken-cookie baking habit, and whether a brisk walk would help.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Linda is Terri's younger sister, lives in Clinton Township, and is close to Terri. Terri says she talks with Linda 'at least twice a week by phone.' Q35 says Terri and Linda cared for their mother together, with Terri handling appointments and paperwork and Linda doing many weekday visits. Q50 says calling her sister is one of Terri's fastest coping strategies.

social_circle.name: Ruth Whitaker

background.how_they_met: Ruth and Terri met through their Methodist church choir and became close through years of rehearsals, worship, service projects, and mutual support.
background.why_close: Ruth notices Terri's anxiety quickly, offers prayer and practical care, and shares Terri's faith, music, reading, and service-oriented values.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses warm full sentences, prayerful language, and occasional heart emojis. She checks in with specific questions rather than vague encouragement.

shared_activities: prayer during family or health worries
recent_text_topics: Choir music folders, refreshments, rehearsal reminders, and hymn choices.
Checking on Terri after school stress or anxious weeks.
The mammogram callback scare and reminding Terri to take the next step instead of carrying everything alone.
Church prayer requests, rides, and who needs a casserole or visit.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Ruth as Terri's church choir friend who 'knows when I am anxious before I say a word' and says Ruth is the first non-family person Terri would call in a difficult moment. Q33 says Terri finally told Ruth about the mammogram callback and Ruth calmed her down. Q47 describes Terri's active Methodist church and choir life.

social_circle.name: Paul Maxson

background.how_they_met: Paul is Terri and Don's adult son, raised in Sterling Heights after their marriage.
background.why_close: Although he lives across the state, Paul remains emotionally close through weekly contact, holidays, long weekends, and conversations that push Terri's thinking.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts casually but clearly, with dry humor, links to articles, and practical tech help. More direct about politics and social issues than Terri.

recent_text_topics: Planning his next visit from the Grand Rapids area and what food Terri should make.
Checking in on whether he is lonely or too busy with work.
Family boundaries around political conversations at holidays.
Tech questions, shared articles, and Paul's more direct views on race and institutions.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Paul is Terri's adult son, lives near Grand Rapids, works in software project management, visits for holidays and long weekends, and talks with Terri by phone every week or so. Q19 says Paul played baseball and was in robotics when younger. Q30 says Terri's children push her thinking, especially Paul, who works with a younger and more diverse group of colleagues.
